I think.|[[Ahsoka Tano]] and Trace Martez|}} The '''''Nebula''-class freighter''' was a type of [[freighter]] that was in use during the [[Clone Wars]]. By [[19 BBY]], the [[pilot]] [[Trace Martez]] owned a heavily-modified ''Nebula''-class freighter that she hoped to turn into a faster vessel which she named the ''[[Silver Angel]]''.{{TCW|Deal No Deal}} {{Ship-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== [[File:SilverAngelFinishingTouches-DND.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano and Trace Martez working on the ''Silver Angel'']] The ''Nebula''-class appears in the seventh season of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Gone with a Trace}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Deal No Deal}} *{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}} *{{TCW|Together Again}} *{{TBB|Decommissioned}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deal-no-deal-episode-guide|text="Deal No Deal" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/decommissioned-episode-guide|text="Decommissioned" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|the-silver-angel|The ''Silver Angel''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Carguero clase Nebulosa |fi=Nebula-luokan rahtialus |ja=ネビュラ級貨物船 |ka=ნისლეულის კლასის საფრახტო გემი |tr=Nebula-sınıfı yük gemisi }} [[Category:Freighter classes]]
